issue.title: Bead note attachments
issue.description: Any file — screenshot, log, trace, archive, or multi-GiB binary — can be attached to a bead note with an inline `@<path>` reference. The bead keeps an immutable snapshot of the bytes that is available on every machine and outlives the source file. Humans see beautiful chips, badges, and optional inline image previews. Agents get plain, extension-preserving file paths.
